verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs claim explicit multi-agent orchestration features ('launch fleets of agents that work in parallel', 'always-on agents on schedules/triggers', unified terminal/Slack/GitHub integration), directly matching the story. However, all support comes from vendor-claimed docs with no independent/community validation of this specific multi-session workspace feature, and general community sentiment flags Cursor as buggy and lagging behind competitors like Claude Code/Codex.
